name: Beat Lamp
description:
Audio-reactive concert lighting, stage effects, 3D laser projectors, fog generators, and redstone signals synced to jukebox music in real time.

Features:
- Beat Lamp: 9 reactive modes (Pulse, RGB, Spectrum, VU Meter, Oscilloscope, Matrix Rain, Ripple, Wave, Scan), 16 dye colors + OLED rainbow, frameless styling, and particle sparks.
- Stage Light: 5 concert moving-head lighting modes (Sweep, Beat Step, Static, Strobe, Chase) with dual-layer atmospheric volumetric beams.
- RGB Laser Projector: 3D multi-beam laser projector (1 to 8 beams) with Fan Sweep, 3D Cone Spin, Static Fan, and Beat Burst.
- Stage Fog Generator: Ground dry-ice fog and high-pressure CO2 jet blasts synced to beat and drops.
- Beat Fountain: Stage pyro jets, structural drop detection, smoke control, 7 particle styles, and real fireworks launches.
- Beat Emitter: 6 Redstone modes (Pulse clock, Drop burst, Continuous 0-15 energy, Kick, Snare, Hi-hat).
- Stage Jukebox: Titanium obsidian jukebox with 100% music disc compatibility and visual vinyl disc slot.
- Master DMX Console: Centralized stage lighting desk with Blackout, Strobe All, Master Dimmer, and remote group control.
- DJ Performance Deck & Stage Line Array Speaker: Premium stage props for concert production.
- Group Linker & Lamp Controller: Intuitive area linking and universal stage device remote configuration.
